# Affordable Housing Online

> > A comprehensive directory of low-income apartments, Section 8 housing, and affordable rental options across the United States, with HUD-verified listings and Fair Market Rent data.

Affordable Housing Online helps renters find income-qualified apartments, public housing, and Housing Choice Voucher properties by searching through thousands of listings organized by city, county, and state. The site provides detailed rental market statistics, housing authority contacts, and eligibility information for HUD programs including Section 8, Project-Based Vouchers, and Public Housing.

## Key Topics

- Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher
- HUD (Housing and Urban Development)
- Fair Market Rent
- Low-Income Apartments
- Public Housing
- Project-Based Voucher
- Housing Authorities
- Income-Based Rentals
- Affordable Housing Programs
- Rental Market Statistics
- Family Self-Sufficiency Program
- Housing Eligibility Requirements
- Moderate Rehabilitation Program
- Rental Vacancy Rates
- Subsidized Housing

- [Low Income Apartments and Affordable Housing For Rent in Section, AL](https://affordablehousingonline.com/housing-search/Alabama/Section): Section, AL affordable housing listings with Fair Market Rent data
